title: 第十九章 得到了水系异能第二十章 假千金被判二十年
slug: 共梦星际大佬后娇娇夜夜被宠哭
content_zh:
“被魅魔控制了不成？”
霍北眉头紧锁，在那令人窒息的黑暗中，他想叫醒她，却又怕强行唤醒会损伤她的心智。
可那味道实在太勾人了。
怀中的小雌性在他怀里不住地颤抖，像是一条缺水的鱼。
因为梦境中的燥热，她无意识地在他坚硬的胸肌和紧绷的腹肌上磨蹭。
那柔软的触感隔着作战服，像是一把把小火苗，瞬间点燃了霍北压抑已久的渴望。
她口中溢出的轻喘声，带着甜腻的钩子，一遍遍冲击着他的理智防线。
“啵。”
因为情动难耐，沈如卿头顶那一对粉嫩的长兔耳朵，不受控制地弹了出来。
红通通的，在黑暗中颤巍巍地抖动着，扫过霍北的下巴，痒到了他心里。
“唔……难受……”
眼看她又要叫出声来，霍北是个血气方刚的军人，哪里受得住这种考验？
脑中名为理智的弦，终于在那一声娇媚的哼唧中，崩断了。
“得罪了！”
他眼底暗沉如墨，猛地伸出手，一把扣住她纤细的腰肢，将人从怀里提了起来，直接让她跨坐在自己结实的大腿上。
为了防止她叫出声被人听到，也为了宣泄心底那股快要爆炸的躁动。
他一手强硬地托住她的后脑勺，猛地低下头，狠狠吻住了那张让他发狂的红唇。
梦里，深海的王座之上。
澜沧看着怀里意乱情迷的小雌性，那双蓝宝石般的眸子里闪过一丝幽光。
只见那条巨大的银蓝色鱼尾在光芒中渐渐虚化，最后竟化作了一双修长有力的双腿。

“小东西，为了你，我可是连鱼尾都收起来了……”
他低笑着，拥有了双腿的鲛人皇子更具侵略性，他在这片属于他的深海领域里，彻底占有了她。
而在现实中，废墟那狭窄逼仄的空间内，暧昧的热度飙升到了顶点。
梦境里的欢愉让沈如卿在现实中更加难耐地扭动。
霍北吻得凶狠而投入，一次又一次地掠夺着她的呼吸。
那双常年握枪，布满薄茧的大手更是没忍住，顺着她被汗水浸湿的衣摆探了进去。
粗砺的指腹划过她细腻如脂的背脊，带起阵阵战栗。
随着吻的深入，他的手不受控制地游走，越过平坦的小腹……
霍北猛地僵住，瞳孔在黑暗中剧烈震颤。
她竟然还是清白之身？
既然她是苍珏元帅的未来雌主，如果元帅已经标记了她，这层阻碍绝不可能还在。
唯一的解释就是，元帅极其珍视她，一直忍着没碰她，想把最美好的时刻留到新婚之夜。
该死！
他差点就做了禽兽不如的事，在这肮脏的废墟里毁了她的清白！
理智如潮水般回归，霍北浑身颤抖，额角青筋暴起，硬生生地停下了指尖的动作。
但他体内的野兽并未完全平息，身体胀得发疼，死死抵着她柔软的腿心。
“唔……”怀里的人儿还在难耐地蹭着他。
霍北深吸一口气，虽然不能真的要她，但他也没舍得放开。
他将她按向自己，隔着衣物，使得两人紧紧贴合在一起，以此来缓解快要爆炸的身体。
他又一次吻住了她，这一次比之前任何一次都要深，都要久，仿佛要将她吞吃入腹。
content_en:
"Are you being controlled by a succubus?"
Huo Bei frowned. In that suffocating darkness, he wanted to wake her up, but he was afraid that forcefully waking her up would damage her mind.
But the smell is so tempting.
The little female in his arms kept trembling in his arms, like a fish out of water.
Because of the heat in the dream, she unconsciously rubbed against his hard chest muscles and tight abdominal muscles.
The soft touch across the combat uniform was like a small flame, instantly igniting Huo Bei's long-suppressed desire.
The soft gasps that escaped her mouth, with a sweet hook, impacted his rational defense line over and over again.
"Bo."
Because she was so moved that she couldn't bear it, the pair of long pink bunny ears on Shen Ruqing's head popped out uncontrollably.
It was bright red and trembling in the darkness. It swept across Huo Bei's chin and tickled his heart.
"Well...it feels uncomfortable..."
Seeing that she was about to scream again, Huo Bei was a hot-blooded soldier, how could he withstand such a test?
The string of reason in his mind finally broke with that charming moan.
"I'm offended!"
His eyes were as dark as ink, and he suddenly reached out his hand, grabbed her slender waist, lifted her up from his arms, and let her sit directly on his strong thighs.
In order to prevent her from screaming out and being heard, and also to vent the restlessness in her heart that was about to explode.
He held the back of her head firmly with one hand, lowered his head suddenly, and kissed the red lips that drove him crazy.
In the dream, on the throne of the deep sea.
Lancang looked at the confused and infatuated little female in his arms, a glimmer of light flashing in his sapphire-like eyes.
I saw the huge silver-blue fish tail gradually disappearing in the light, and finally turned into a pair of slender and powerful legs.
"Little one, for you, I even put away the tail of the fish..."
He chuckled. The Mermaid Prince was even more aggressive now that he had legs. He completely possessed her in this deep sea area that belonged to him.
But in reality, in the narrow and cramped space of the ruins, the ambiguous heat soared to its peak.
The joy in the dream made Shen Ruqing twist even more unbearably in reality.
Huo Bei kissed her fiercely and passionately, taking her breath away again and again.
Those big, calloused hands that had been holding guns all year round couldn't help but penetrated along the hem of her sweat-soaked clothes.
The rough fingertips traced her delicate and fat back, causing waves of shivers.
As the kiss deepened, his hands wandered uncontrollably, crossing his flat belly...
Huo Bei froze suddenly, his pupils trembling violently in the darkness.
She is still innocent?
Since she is Marshal Cang Jue's future female protagonist, if the Marshal has marked her, this obstacle will never remain.
The only explanation is that the marshal cherishes her very much and has resisted touching her, wanting to save the best moments for the wedding night.
Damn it!
He almost did something worse than a beast and ruined her innocence in this dirty ruins!
Reason returned like a tide, Huo Bei trembled all over, veins popped out on his forehead, and he abruptly stopped moving his fingertips.
But the beast inside him had not completely calmed down. His body was so swollen that it hurt, and he was pressing against the soft core of her legs.
"Well..." The person in his arms was still rubbing against him impatiently.
Huo Bei took a deep breath. Although he couldn't really want her, he was not willing to let her go.
He pressed her towards him, making the two of them tightly together through the clothes, in order to relieve the body that was about to explode.
He kissed her again, this time deeper and longer than any before, as if he wanted to devour her.
